reason: I always get three quotes from local firms and go with the middle one, and a lone freelancer in Kuwait with no UK clients or reviews wouldn't make my shortlist. Paying only when I'm happy is nice, but my worry isn't the build, it's who picks up the phone in a year when the site breaks.
objection: He's in Kuwait, not Manchester, with nobody local vouching for him. If something breaks or he moves on, I'm stuck with a site and a £43 monthly plan with nobody to chase.
would_change_my_mind: Someone in my local business Facebook group saying he built their site and still answers quickly months later.
